FX-SPOTGEL-001.says: Render gel only, the paint as the gel, the light straight down on the middle, opening 90 degrees: the drawing is gone and the paint is projected in a round pool, its long side across the pool, fading at the edge.

FX-SPOTGEL-002.says: Render gel add: the paint's light added to the drawing where it is covered; the transparent corner at the bottom right stays transparent.

FX-SPOTGEL-003.says: Render gel add plus, the light straight down on the transparent corner at the bottom right: the paint's light falls on the transparent part too.

FX-SPOTGEL-004.says: Render gel shadow, the slide as the gel: outside the cone black, inside the drawing as it was where the slide is clear and tinted blue under its cross.

FX-SPOTGEL-005.says: Render gel add with no gel layer: exactly light add.

FX-SPOTGEL-006.says: Render light add with the paint named as the gel: a Light render ignores the gel, so exactly light add.

FX-SPOTGEL-007.says: Gel add, the small paint (8 by 6) as the gel: centred on the drawing, so its light is the paint's in the middle and white around it.

FX-SPOTGEL-008.says: Gel add, the gel a layer that starts at frame 4: plain white light before, the slide from frame 4.

FX-SPOTGEL-009.says: Gel add, the gel layer "gone" not in the composition: the drawing unchanged, warned every frame.

FX-SPOTGEL-010.says: Gel only, the light low at the top left, height 20, opening 60: the paint is drawn out into a long oval.

FX-SPOTGEL-011.says: Gel add, an orange light at intensity 250 through the slide: orange light past 1 through the clear parts, darker under the cross.

FX-SPOTGEL-012.says: Gel shadow at intensity 50 through the paint: outside the cone half as dark, inside tinted by the paint.

FX-SPOTGEL-013.says: Gel only, the holder itself as the gel: its own drawing projected onto the cleared layer.

FX-SPOTGEL-014.says: Gel add, opening 180: the gel's spread is held at 89 degrees, so its middle colours the whole lit drawing.

FX-SPOTGEL-015.says: Gel add with From keyed from [30, 50] at frame 0 to [70, 50] at frame 4, linear: the gel slides and stretches as the light swings.

FX-SPOTGEL-016.says: FX-SPOTGEL-004 on an adjustment layer above the drawing: the same.

FX-SPOTGEL-017.says: FX-SPOTGEL-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved, light and all.

FX-SPOTGEL-018.says: Gel add, the light along the drawing (height 0) from the left middle to the right middle: the axis lies along x, so the gel's across is the drawing's y.

FX-SPOTGEL-019.says: A gel layer written as the number 3, not a word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPOTGEL-020.says: Render "Gel_Add": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPOTGEL-021.says: Render "gel_glow": not one of CC Spotlight's renders. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

cycle_two.json.says: `a` and `b`, each the holder's drawing, each with a CC Spotlight rendering gel add whose gel layer is the other: refused, `EFFECT_LAYER_CYCLE`.

light_names_other.json.says: The same two layers with Light renders: a Light render never reads its gel layer, so there is no cycle and the file opens.
